jtbd.situation: The agent is tested and its prompt names the things it must say per person; a list of 500 patients is in a spreadsheet
happySteps: In Deployment, on the batch tab, Sam opens New run and uploads the contact list.
Sam maps each {{variable}} to a list column and picks the from number.
Sam sets calling windows by weekday, pacing, call policy, voicemail and lifecycle.
Sam sees the estimated minutes against free minutes left, then starts now or schedules.

rationale: The CSV read: count, rejected count, Download rejects, one line why; an error on the dropzone for a file with no phone column — .b, learning 1, requirement 7
A select per variable, pre-filled by name; the start blocked with a reason only for a variable with neither column nor default — .c, learning 2, P0.4
Calling windows by weekday with a range, time zone, Add a range, Add another window; Start on a date beside Start now — .a step 3, learning 2, requirement 48
"Outside the calling windows now. Dialing starts Mon 09:00." before the press; the panel and the row repeat it after — .d, learning 3
Pacing: Sessions at once capped at 10, Dials per second, Attempts per contact, Wait between attempts — .a step 3, learning 4, API truth
